text.en:
Damaging 3 enemies within ? seconds of each generates 50% Blight.

Blighted Seekers deal <pve 160 /> <pvp [6.85] /> damage in a 3 meter radius each and chain two additional times to enemies within a 10 meter radius.

Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.
